answer_1.quote: We create synthetic training data that cover the missing patterns in the human generated dataset... We create template-based instructions that correspond to the patterns... we paraphrase the instructions using GPT4-o.

answer_2.quote: Interested in quantifying the effect of patterns in the training data on agent performance... we use the following metrics: • Task Completion (TC)... • Overshoot Rate (OSR)... • Orientation... Precision, Recall and F1 scores.
